prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1456; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just leave that off for now, if that's alright. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?
A: It was on the highway in Sugar Land, Texas, in the right lane, heading toward the exit ramp.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?
A: I was changing lanes. I checked my mirror, saw the lane was clear, and started moving over. Then I heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed sideways.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Not really. It came up in my blind spot, I think. I didn't see it until the contact happened.

Q: Did you see any turn signal from the other driver?
A: I don't remember seeing one. It all happened pretty fast.

Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My neck snapped back and then forward when we hit. The next morning I had stiffness and pain across the back of my neck and shoulders, and it's been hard to turn my head to the left.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: I went to urgent care that same afternoon, and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then.

Q: Did you miss any work because of your injuries?
A: I missed a few days, and I've been limiting how long I drive because sitting upright for long periods makes it worse.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want to be clear that I was signaling and checking my mirrors before I moved over. That's really all I can tell you.
